evals.prompt: Preciso de um orçamento comercial para uma API de consulta criminal (ORCRIM): autenticação, busca por documento, histórico de consultas e exportação CSV. Versão orcamento-api-orcrim. Pode gravar em docs.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies with ≤5 questions including team experience when hours will be estimated (or marks assumption). Loads docs/context reverse-spec/brownfield when present. Produces PT-BR commercial-budget.md with Features (Feature 00N, precedence + acceptance; not RF labeling), FP + COSMIC E/R/W/X + hours previstas sized as delta when context exists. No Investimento / R$ section. No tasks/, no requirements.md, no GitLab issues. Stops after persist + next-step offer.

evals.prompt: quick mode: portal do cliente B2B — login, listar pedidos, detalhe do pedido, PDF da nota. Time sênior, 2 anos no produto, core maintainers. Produtividade 8h/PF. Gere o orçamento.
evals.expected_output: Skips full clarification; marks remaining assumptions. Client doc in PT-BR with ≤10 Features, FP, COSMIC rollup, hours using 8h/PF grounded in stated team experience. No Investimento / R$. No gold-plated dashboards. No SDD task generation.

evals.prompt: Monta proposta comercial em inglês for a small inventory API: SKU CRUD + stock adjust. Chat only, don't write files.
evals.expected_output: Deliverable in English because explicitly requested. Chat-only (no docs/versions write). FP + COSMIC + hours present; no monetary pricing. May ask or assume team experience for hours. No task list. Does not invoke ns-project-manager forecast or SDD workers.
